description: Two replacement-mesh Stumpys and two engine-rendered Raiders on the selbox-slope hillside at facing 200 — the regression fixture for the body-turn fold in hires_pose (model-import.md). VEHICLES on purpose: TA keeps a Kbot upright, so a Kbot's body triple is heading-only and a Kbot fixture cannot see this bug at all. The Raiders are the oracle — the engine tilts them with the terrain, so a replacement mesh posed with the heading alone stands square while they lean. Needs hires/armstump.glb, which is 'tools/ta3do export armstump' (not shipped: it is derived from the retail model). Facing 200 rather than a multiple of 90 so a yaw convention that is a reflection or an inverse cannot render correctly by accident.
